subject: Status: maze repro done, subgoals earn their keep, SV2P is the bottleneck
body:
Hi both,

Repro status: the full chain runs - generate_data, SV2P training through tensor2tensor, then train_vae, train_tdm and train_tap, finishing with meta_cem on the medium-difficulty maze at horizon 50. Results match the release qualitatively: with one generated subgoal (numsg=1) planning success on medium mazes roughly doubles versus flat CEM with pixel cost, and TDM cost outperforms pixel cost on the harder layouts. That's the headline for the 5/6 review.

Bottleneck: SV2P. Training it for our own simulation env is 5x the maze data volume, and on best-effort titan we keep getting preempted - Bilal estimates the run loses a third of its throughput to restarts. Either we accept an April 24 -> May 1 slip on the env port, or Bruno escalates for a short reserved slice.

Also, teh conditional VAE occasionally generates subgoals behind walls; filtering candidates through the TDM cost before planning fixes it cheaply. Writing that up as a recommended default.

Carmen
